Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Metal Shelf, 24"W, Black
Colors: Black
Materials: Iron
This space-saving shelf with hidden brackets gives you a place to show off photos and other treasured objects -- and the flexibility to change them quickly and easily at any time. The black painted iron brings a modern industrial edge to any room. 24" W x 2" H x 3.63" D Made of black painted iron Ready to hang, all hardware included
